t: This is the King's Building, the founding building of King's College London, on the Strand Campus. It is Grade I listed. Originally called the College Building, it was designed by Sir Robert Smirke and built between 1829 and 1831, on land granted by the government to complete the riverside frontage of Somerset House. Smirke was one of the leaders of Greek Revival architecture, and he also designed the main block and façade of the British Museum. He was a pioneer in the use of structural iron and concrete foundations.
